I think it's a fairly insightful summary of the dating market. And I would propose a corollary that PUA doesn't really help with this situation. If you believe the evidence that women are only really attracted to the top 20%, or whatever the percentage is, then you have to understand that it's a zero-sum situation. As you improve, you're pushing some other poor bastard out of the market, and vice versa.

Worse, if you do succeed, what have you really won? As the article points out, you'll only be landing a woman who spent every year since puberty with guys much better than you - a woman who believes with all her heart that she deserves one of those guys (and why shouldn't she?) and as a result, will never see you as more than a plan B that she begrudgingly accepted. It's kind of an insult when you think about it.

What all of this comes down to is that your time is perhaps better spent on other pursuits. I haven't dated in a while, although I am still open to it (and I know a lot of MGTOWs still date) but what I absolutely will not do is allow my personal happiness to be determined by success for failure in dating. That is the exact opposite of going my own way.

It'll be interesting to see how this plays out in the future. For the past decade, post-prime women looking to settle down have had an increasingly hard time doing so. There are a number of reasons for this; women tend to date across and up, but not really across and down,and the number of "eligible" men are decreasing year after year. Another reason is that men are more aware of women's dualistic mating strategy (known as "alpha fucks, beta bucks") and, concluding that that dynamic is "as good as it gets" have opted to either learn PUA or GTOW.

There has always been a compromise between the genders. Men want sex, and women want security. Marriage, for all it's pitfalls, was a negotiated system between men and women that allowed most people to access companionship, sex, and reproduction, and gave women the "security" they yearn for.

Now that women are "liberated" from this system to pursue their own dualistic mating strategy (alpha fucks, beta bucks) and the internet has allowed men to talk about and become aware of said system, many post-prime women looking to settle down are having a harder time doing so as men are opting out of that.

It seems women will either have to capitulate and accept the older system (whether it includes legal marriage or some new convention) or accept loneliness past-prime.

Also, while it may be quicker to go to your wrist, rather than pull out your phone, doing anything on your wrist seems to take longer - so it's uncertain how much time you actually save.

The result was a backlash that meant that the theme often became anti-religion, which is a different concept from atheism.

I'm hoping, and I have seen a few comments, and happy to see they weren't rejected either, of people saying that this site doesn't need to actively be anti-reddit.
